007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Conversation;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.Session;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.ConversationAttributes;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
016import org.slf4j.Logger;
017import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
018
019/**
020 * Sample for calling {@link Profile#chatSession(Conversation)}.
021 *
022 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, obtain a
023 * {@link Profile}, configure a conversation, start a conversation-backed
024 * {@link Session}, call {@link Session#chat(String)}, and leave the created
025 * conversation in the database when the session is closed. The conversation is
026 * not deleted because this sample uses the default
027 * {@link Profile#chatSession(Conversation)} behavior.</p>
028 *
029 * <p>This sample changes database state by creating a conversation. Drop the
030 * conversation after the sample completes if it is no longer required.</p>
031 *
032 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
033 * <ul>
034 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
035 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
036 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
037 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
038 * </ul>
039 *
040 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
041 * <ul>
042 *   <li>SELECTAI_SESSION_PROMPT_1 - chat prompt. Defaults to a sample prompt.</li>
043 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_TITLE - conversation title.</li>
044 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_DESCRIPTION - conversation description.</li>
045 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_RETENTION_DAYS - retention period. Defaults to {@code 7}.</li>
046 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_LENGTH - conversation length. Defaults to {@code 20}.</li>
047 * </ul>
048 *
049 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
050 * <pre>{@code
051 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
052 * }</pre>
053 *
054 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK JAR and copy runtime
055 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
056 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
057 * <pre>{@code
058 * mvn clean install
059 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
060 * }</pre>
061 *
062 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
063 * <pre>{@code
064 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
065 *   -d samples/out \
066 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/ChatSessionWithoutDeleteSample.java
067 * }</pre>
068 *
069 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
070 * <pre>{@code
071 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
072 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.ChatSessionWithoutDeleteSample
073 * }</pre>
074 *
075 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
076 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
077 * and diagnostics.</p>
078 */
079public final class ChatSessionWithoutDeleteSample {
080    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ChatSessionWithoutDeleteSample.class);
081
082    private ChatSessionWithoutDeleteSample() {
083    }
084
085    public static void main(String[] args) {
086        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
087        String prompt = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_SESSION_PROMPT_1",
088                "What is the importance of history of science?");
089
090        try {
091            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
092            Profile profile = selectAI.profile(profileName);
093            Conversation conversation = selectAI.conversation(ConversationAttributes.builder()
094                    .title(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_TITLE", "Java SDK Chat Session"))
095                    .description(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_DESCRIPTION",
096                            "Conversation created by the Java Select AI SDK chat session sample."))
097                    .retentionDays(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_RETENTION_DAYS", "7")))
098                    .conversationLength(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_LENGTH", "20")))
099                    .build());
100
101            try (Session session = profile.chatSession(conversation)) {
102                System.out.printf("Conversation ID: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(conversation.getConversationId()));
103                System.out.printf("Chat response:%n%s%n", valueOrEmpty(session.chat(prompt)));
104            }
105        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
106            LOGGER.error("Failed to run chat session for Select AI profile '{}'.", profileName, e);
107        }
108    }
109
110    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
111        return SelectAI.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
112                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
113                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
114                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
115                .build());
116    }
117
118    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
119        String value = System.getenv(name);
120        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
121            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
122        }
123        return value;
124    }
125
126    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
127        String value = System.getenv(name);
128        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
129    }
130
131    private static String valueOrEmpty(String value) {
132        return value == null ? "" : value;
133    }
134}
